subject: Payment path follow-up — procurement constraints & potential exception for pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpointhealth.com>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T16:12:00-05:00
Subject: Quick recap + procurement question (pilot next steps)

Hi Sophie / Marcus — great to meet today, thank you for the time. Quick recap and a short set of asks so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost on a representative workload, then discuss Dedicated if ROI checks out.
- Proposed pilot: Hosted API, 50k tokens/week, one model variant, shared eval rubric.
- Next step: commercial path — what billing/payment route does ClearPoint prefer for pilots?

On the call you mentioned there are constraints from AP: sometimes card charges are disallowed for vendor subscriptions and they require a PO for any recurring/sustained spend. Can you confirm if that’s a hard block for a short pilot or if there’s any flexibility (e.g., corporate card for < $5k, or prepay arrangement)? If PO is required, what is the typical lead time and who on your side owns issuing it?

I’ve attached a one-pager on the pilot scope. If you prefer, we can also execute a short SOW and pilot invoice (I can route through Finance for a prepay option).

Proposed dates: start week of Jan 4. Happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up with your AP contact if that helps.

Thanks — Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0148
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_scope-onepager.docx

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpointhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@clearpointhealth.com>, AP Team <ap@clearpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement question (pilot next steps)

Thanks Vivek — appreciated the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- High level: ClearPoint has a vendor policy that requires a PO for any multi-month engagements or subscriptions. For one-off purchases, corporate card is ok but only up to $3k per transaction.
- Pilots that look like ongoing subscriptions (monthly invoicing) will typically need a PO and Net-30 processing.
- Marketplace purchases (AWS/Azure/GCP) sometimes allow card or marketplace billing and can expedite procurement — we are open to that if you are listed.

AP note (copied): we can start the PO process but it usually takes 7–10 business days after the SOW is signed and we have vendor tax/W9 info. If you have a pilot invoice or SOW, please send and we’ll queue it.

We are definitely interested — looking to validate performance before committing to Dedicated. For the pilot, would Redwood consider either: 

1) A short prepay (3 months) billed via invoice (PO) 
2) A single-card charge for an initial one-month pilot if kept under $3k
3) Marketplace purchase if Redwood is available there

Attaching our internal procurement policy excerpt for reference.

— Sophie
Sophie Lang
Director, Product Strategy | ClearPoint Health
sophie.lang@clearpointhealth.com

Attachments: clearpoint_procurement_policy.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:18:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement question (pilot next steps) — need billing path guidance

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the procurement constraints from ClearPoint (thread above). They are very interested but AP requires either PO for multi-month or card under $3k. They also flagged marketplace as an accelerator.

Options I see: 
- Option A (fast): Offer a single-month pilot billed to card for $2,750 (keeps under their $3k card threshold). Low friction, fastest start.
- Option B (compliant): Issue a 3-month prepay invoice and ask them to raise a PO against that invoice. We can offer 10% discount for prepay. Slower (7–10 business days) but cleaner for procurement.
- Option C (longer term): Work with Partner/Marketplace team to get listed so AP can buy there — good for scale but not immediate.

Can we confirm (a) whether Sales Ops/Finance can accept card for a $2,750 pilot and what approvals are needed, and (b) whether we can generate a pilot invoice/SOW they can attach to a PO request? If we go prepay, I’ll ask for the PO and routing info.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/489
Pilot scope attached.

Thanks — Vivek

[forwarded attachments: clearpoint_procurement_policy.pdf, pilot_scope-onepager.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement question (pilot next steps) — recommended path

Vivek — thanks for the note and the clear options. Recommendation from Finance / Sales Ops below: 

Summary of recommended path for speed + compliance:
- Primary: Offer the $2,750 single-month pilot charged to card (option A) to start within Jan week 1. This is low-friction and fits their <$3k card threshold. Finance approves card charges up to $5k for pilot/PO-exception with AE sign-off and a pilot invoice stub (we create).
- Backup: If they insist on PO for the pilot, we should provide a 3-month prepay invoice with a 10% prepay discount (option B). Finance will accept a PO and process Net-30 after the prepay is captured — lead time ~7–10 business days.
- Marketplace: We can engage the Partnerships team but that is a longer lead time and not recommended for an immediate pilot.

Action items: 
1) Vivek: send AP contact details and confirm card vs PO preference.
2) Sales Ops (Marissa): will generate a pilot invoice stub ("pilot_invoice_stub.pdf") and an internal approval note allowing up to $5k card for pilots with AE sign-off.
3) Karthik: if legal needs to sign a one-off SOW, advise scope minimality — otherwise we’ll use standard T&Cs already in HubSpot.

I’m attaching the invoice stub and will loop in Finance Ops to approve the charge path. If ClearPoint wants PO-only, we’ll route the 3-month prepay.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: pilot_invoice_stub.pdf
